text: dsh-quit-idle-fix 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的插件，用于消除空闲会话退出时的误报。它通过 Cordis bundle 注册后台清理逻辑，在 agent 空闲且没有待处理用户回合时，定期移除审批策略、工作目录、Cordis 插件运行结果和计划模式产生的指定 next-step 提示。插件会在加载时立即清理，并每 500 毫秒检查一次；运行中的 agent 和已有排队用户回合不受影响。适合希望退出桌面应用时不再把残留系统提示误认为运行中任务的用户。使用 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 至 0.3.0 前版本的桌面 profile 安装，不需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-quit-idle-fix is a DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that clears selected system notices from idle agents, preventing a false active-task warning when quitting. It skips running agents and queued user turns, and requires no API key or external service.
退出桌面端时老提示任务还在跑，怎么消除空闲会话里的误报？
想清掉空闲 agent 收到的审批或计划模式通知，但保留真正的用户消息。
How can I stop stale system notices from making an idle desktop session look busy when I quit?
dsh-quit-idle-fix 的功能「清理空闲提示」：加载时立即检查并每 500 毫秒扫描。仅在 agent 空闲且无排队用户回合时移除四类系统提示，保留运行中的 agent 和普通用户消息。

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · dsh-quit-idle-fix：Stop the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from warning that running tasks will be
interrupted when the only thing left in the idle inbox is a system notice.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · The false alarm：The desktop quit check in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host` counts **any** pending
`next-step` inbox message as active work:

```js
agent.status === "running" ||
agent.inbox.nextTurn.length > 0 ||
agent.inbox.nextStep.length > 0
```

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · The false alarm：But several host features queue purely informational messages with
`agent.inject()`, which does **not** wake an idle agent. When the approval
policy, working directory, plan mode, or a Cordis plugin changes while a
conversation is idle, the notice waits in `next-step` forever. The quit check
then sees a pending message and warns about interrupted work even though no
turn and no job is running.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · The false alarm：This is an interaction bug in the harness itself (the official
`dsh-desktop-host` predicate plus the official notice producers), not a
conflict caused by another installed plugin.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · What this plugin does：While an agent is `idle`, it consumes `next-step` messages whose
`source.kind` is one of:

- `user-approval` — approval policy changed
- `working-directory` — working directory changed or recovered
- `cordis-host-runner` — plugin add/remove/run result
- `plan-mode` — plan mode switched

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · What this plugin does：The approval policy and working directory are already stated in the runtime
context, and plan mode is reflected in the prompt. Cordis plugin state can be
inspected again with the plugin tools. Running agents are never touched, so a
notice queued mid-turn still reaches the next step. If a user turn is already
queued, the sweep backs off and lets that turn consume the notices.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · What this plugin does：It checks every 500 ms, does an immediate sweep on load, and keeps no state.
Agents with a queued `next-turn` user message are skipped.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · Install：From npm (recommended once published):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-quit-idle-fix
```

From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:shuaichewang/dsh-quit-idle-fix
```

Or install it from the plugin marketplace. Restart the desktop app if the
change does not take effect immediately.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-quit-idle-fix
```

Restart the app afterwards.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · Verify：```sh
node test.mjs

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · ok: idle notices removed, running agent untouched, timer disposed：```

Then make sure no conversation is running and no background job is active,
and quit the desktop app. The interrupt warning should no longer appear. If a
real job or turn is running, the warning still appears — that is intended.
section: ok: idle notices removed, running agent untouched, timer disposed

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · Scope and limitations：- Desktop only. The web profile has no quit-confirmation dialog.
- Only the four notice kinds above are cleared. A future feature (or a
  third-party plugin) that injects a different kind while idle can still
  trigger the false alarm; open an issue if that happens.
- It does not touch `next-turn`, real user messages, running agents, jobs, or
  scheduled tasks.
- It reads the in-memory agent list and inbox only. No network, no file access,
  no credentials.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · Upstream fix：The cleaner fix belongs in `dsh-desktop-host`: do not count notice-shaped
`next-step` messages as active work, or avoid leaving non-waking notices in the
inbox. This plugin is a workaround that survives app signature checks because
it installs as a profile bundle instead of modifying `app.asar`.

dsh-quit-idle-fix README · 中文说明：DeepSeek Harness 桌面端退出前会把任何待处理的 `next-step` 消息都当成“有任务”。
但切换审批策略、工作目录、计划模式或增删插件时，官方功能用 `agent.inject()`
投递的只是提示消息，并不会唤醒空闲会话，于是提示永远留在队列里，退出时就会
误弹“当前正在运行的任务将会中断”。

这个插件只在 agent 空闲时清掉上述四类提示；正在运行的会话完全不受影响。
真实任务、后台作业和已排程提醒仍会正常触发退出警告。

安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-quit-idle-fix
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-quit-idle-fix
```
